interpretation: All100 words and102 lexical pieces are preserved by route audit as61 planned routes; no word was omitted from the workload. This is textual routing proof, not native-listener acoustic word accuracy.
Between-feed intervals exclude time inside WavePlayer.feed. Feed call blocking is distinct from producer/consumer scheduling, and neither directly proves a CPU synthesis stall.
The two high-NCC trials support testing bounded lookahead against intermittent starvation; repeated24/32 results still vary, so current results do not establish a reliable fix or optimum.
All native packet device positions are0, preserving strict continuity/clock and cancellation blockers even for complete high-NCC waveforms.
The first feed starts3.15-3.26seconds after the public read in all trials. More lookahead is not a remedy or acceptance for that separate cold-start delay.
Reference-frame locations of long feed intervals are software emitted-PCM positions. They are not assigned to particular words or called audible gaps without appropriate acoustic/clock evidence.
Each trial uses its own complete emitted reference; different references have different hashes. No common remembered recording or fitted waveform was substituted.
